common_rules: CLAUDE.md is binding: dependency direction, venues are providers to everything, VOCABULARY depends on nothing, one home per subject, only what is true today (no history, no plans outside docs/planning/), a doc is about its own subject.

Verify every claim against the CURRENT code when you write it. Review line numbers are from ac10a6c and are stale; much code has changed since (git log --oneline ac10a6c..HEAD). The review's suggested wording is a starting point, never a fact. When code contradicts a review item, the code wins and the doc describes the code.
Edit only the files your group owns (its 'files' list). A needed change in another group's file goes into your final report, never into the file.

Docs only. You may edit prose, comments in config files you own, and docblocks/comments in the source files you own. You never change behaviour, configuration values or tests. Where a review item prescribes a code or config change, check whether a code unit landed it; describe the code as it is and list any gap in your report.

Moves between groups: the destination group writes the content, reading the source as it stood at the plan baseline (git show b8f0ca6:<path>); the source group deletes its copy and leaves at most a one-line pointer. Neither waits for the other. Move only what is still true; drop what is not.

Links: point at a file, or at a heading listed under 'Promised anchors' in DOCS-PLAN.md; never at code lines (file.ts#L123). Code docblocks point at docs by file, not by anchor. A pointer to a doc you do not depend on must not be needed to understand your doc. Run a link and anchor check over your files before finishing (scratchpad/reviews/scratch/links.py or equivalent).
Use the terms of the 'Terminology' section of DOCS-PLAN.md.
DEFER items are not acted on; where a DEFER blocks a restructure, keep the current arrangement and fix accuracy only.
Every services/*/README.md you own gets one line 'Deployed by: <module or pack>' or 'Deployed by: no module' (DXC-23), verified against the compose `include`/`path:` entries.
Final report: items resolved, items partly resolved or moot (with why), code/doc gaps found, changes needed in other groups' files.
terminology: vault: the Parquet vault stocker writes. The CSV store in services/vault is 'the vault service' wherever it could be confused (not renamed: DCOL-17 / DPLT-25 deferred).
source: archives, REST or WS (VOCABULARY). 'origin' is used only as the `cold` CLI argument (the tree a command acts on: archives or vault); prose says 'tree'.

bucket: only an S3 bucket. The venue-wide `@` file is the 'market bundle (`@`)'; stocker's time bucket is a 'period'. The catalog's `buckets` JSON field keeps its name and is described as the count of market-bundle files.

slice: VOCABULARY's slice. A lens is a 'named selection', never a 'named slice'. Stocker's directory is a 'vault slice' (defined once in STOCKER.md#path-convention). Prospector's write queue is 'the serial write queue'.
partition: VOCABULARY's (slice x month). Prospector's walk unit with a cursor and a `run` row is a 'scope'; a pass over a venue is a 'job'.
reconciliation: only prospector's reconcile() after a finished pass. Comparing against a venue's instrument listing is 'the preamble'.
Shape, Table, Origin, and the `@` spelling of the market bundle are defined in VOCABULARY.md (entry group); other docs use them without redefining.
Revision of a file in prospector: 'the file's previous version (`revision` table)'; VOCABULARY's Revision is the vault stocking identity.

groups.name: entry
groups.instructions:
Schedule LAST: README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md link into every other group's docs, and you run the final repo-wide link check.
1. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (create; about one page; present tense). One ASCII diagram: prospector -> catalog (+ lenses) -> hauler -> archives -> stocker -> Parquet vault, with `./tools cold` backing up the archives, the vault and the catalog. One paragraph per stage on the boundary it owns, linking docs/services/<X>.md. The modules that deploy them (docs/modules/ARCHIVES.md, modules/store/warehouse/README.md) and the services no module deploys (hoarder, router, pipe, the vault service, the UI stub), said plainly without 'parked'/'not yet'. The principle: collection is byte-faithful, normalisation is a separate pass. Source priority bulk -> REST -> WS: ARCHITECTURE.md is its single deep home (decision: README keeps its short pitch and points here; DXC-02 and DPLT-03 disagreed). The collectors at overview depth. WebSocket: 'the WebSocket section of each venue doc that has one (BINANCE, BYBIT, OKX, KRAKEN)' (DXC-29 pointer part). The vault layout only by pointer to STOCKER.md#path-convention, never 'one file per instrument' (DXC-04, DSTK-03, DSTK-15). The vault service only as the store holding the BitMEX dataset (pointer to docs/bitmex/README.md and services/VAULT.md). No venue names, no history, no plans, no restatement of stocker's schema rules.
2. docs/DATA_PIPELINE.md: delete. Its plans (Replay, 'Origins arrive one at a time', WS/REST collection status) are written into docs/planning/ROADMAP.md by planning; its BitMEX paragraph goes into docs/bitmex/README.md (you); 'Retired' and 'Where raw lands' history are dropped. Re-point every link you own that targets it.
3. README.md (DXC-02, DPLT-05, DTL-10, DXC-11 README.md:55 part): point readers at ARCHITECTURE.md; doc table rows for ARCHITECTURE.md, VOCABULARY.md, docs/planning/ (ROADMAP there), docs/tooling/ = the `./tools` developer CLI (dev/tooling) including `./tools cold`, and one line that `tb` is the dx compose wrapper (verify the new ./tb script, commit b8f0ca6); docs/services/ = one reference per documented service; docs/modules/ described as it is today (module docs plus the catalog API and lens references; do not move them, DXC-32 deferred); docs/bitmex/ = a dataset this repo collected, not the venue (DPLT-20). Verify the .env claims against how dx/./tb load env. Keep the venue-naming rule paragraph.
4. docs/VOCABULARY.md (DPLT-13, DPLT-16, DSTK-16, DXC-10, DTL-10): definitions only. Fix Partition, Revision, Run, Snapshot, Catalog and Chain per those items; strip every operation or behaviour (Snapshot mechanics are written into COLD-CATALOG.md by tooling; Run's one-unfinished-run rule into PROSPECTOR.md by prospector-doc; delete them here). Add: Shape; Table; under Bundle that the market bundle is spelled `@`; Origin (cold storage, not a source); under Vault 'not the vault service (services/vault)'; one-liners for Series, Canonical key, Seed, Tip, Floor, Era, Ledger, Backfill only where the term is used in several docs, each meaning taken from its home doc. No venue facts, no service internals. Follow the Terminology section; other groups rely on it.
5. docs/bitmex (DPLT-20, SHR-06): README names the source suffixes (.s3, .local, .antel, .mtav, .tardis, .prepared, .mongo; one line each), a 4-6 line 'What was done to it' summary of the two logs, and DATA_PIPELINE's BitMEX paragraph if not already covered; `git mv` DEDUP_COMPARISON.md and dedup_validation_2026.md to dev/tooling/.deprecated/data/docs/ unchanged; TABLES.md points only at services/vault/src/data/headers.ts (columns) and casts.ts (typing). Stays out of docs/venues (it names services).
6. .github/copilot-instructions.md: already corrected upstream; verify its two links only.
7. DXC-20 final pass: after all groups, run the link and anchor checker over every in-scope .md (exclude submodules, node_modules, .deprecated, the external ../tradebot-sim links). Fix your own files; report the rest to the orchestrator with file and target.
The DXC-10 renames inside other groups' files are listed in their instructions; you own only the definitions.

Prune (DXC-03, DPLT-04, DPLT-15, DPLT-17): delete the first-haul section (it stays in planning/CATALOG.md#hauler), the 'week or two' estimate, 'Iteration 1', the seed-rebuild paragraph, the SCOPING paragraph, the `scattered`/`subject` bullets and the cited BUGS entries that are gone; replace the `.pNN.tar` sentence with a pointer to ../tooling/COLD.md; cut the cold-storage account to the goal plus that pointer (DTL-10); 'origin' -> 'source'; 'market' -> 'instrument at a venue' where an instrument is meant (Part 3 heading 'Categorise the instruments'); okx's 'drop' on 404 becomes one line pointing to CATALOG.md#prospector; the bot entry: 'out of scope until replay exists; no current plan' (DPLT-21); the tradebot-sim links become plain text. Infra units changed these files since the review (96bb544 prod image, e8d0ebd loopback ports and required credentials, e8c4612 unique compose projects / market cache / compose comments, 8bbba2f env examples, b8f0ca6 ./tb network): read the files, not the review.
docker/README.md (DXC-14 = DPLT-07 = INF-12, DPLT-01): rewrite from the four Dockerfiles and two entrypoints: APP_ENV selects docker/${APP_ENV}.node.Dockerfile with the repo root as context; build args SERVICE_NAME and NODE_MEMORY_MB; the prod image as it is after INF-01/05/11 (entry point dist/src/index.js); the dev image (runtime only, /live mount, runs what the host's last `pnpm build` produced); data dirs owned by uid 1000; the real .dockerignore; the python pair in one line (DPLT-26 deferred). No npm, no 'minimal image', no consumer services named.
modules/infra/README.md (DXC-13, DPLT-08): one table, pack x {queue, queue-rt, cache} with the actual service names and hostnames from the five compose files; the root .env.example variables they read; no DB_*, no nonexistent modules, no per-pack anchors, no replay/REST claims. Describe each pack only by what it defines (DXC-22 over DPLT-08's consumer list). DPLT-23 is deferred: document the packs as they are. Header comments of the five compose files (DXC-13 step 3): verify, fix comment text only.
services/rabbitmq/README.md (DXC-13, DPLT-14) and services/redis/README.md (DXC-13, DPLT-22): each on its own terms (image and version, credentials, ports and what empty means, config files or volume, service name); no consumers, no fabricated snippets, no `tb up infra`; pack hostnames by pointer to modules/infra/README.md; each with a 'Deployed by' line naming the packs.
Root .env.example (DPLT-02, DPLT-09, DCOL-05 VAULT_URL): comments on their own line; DATA_DIR marked required; correct role notes for queue, queue-rt and cache; delete the REGISTRY section, QUEUE_RT_URL and VAULT_URL only after grep shows nothing reads them (otherwise correct them: vault is on port 8000); mark the vault-service section as services/vault's, which no module deploys. Guarding DATA_DIR in compose is config: report only.
services/_stub/ui/README.md (DXC-15, DCAT-05, SUI-02): present tense; a BitMEX-era React/Vite stub that no module deploys, wired against BitMEX REST/WS and the retired digger; what exists (the data layer: BitmexClient over WsClient, EnvProvider, DataProvider; the widget hooks; which widgets render mockData.ts; grid layout persistence), the variables vite.config.ts and compose actually read, the real start commands (no `tb up gui/bitmex`); 'Deployed by: no module'; the intended design by pointer to docs/planning/UI.md (planning creates it; docs/services/UI.md is deleted, link nothing there). Decision: SUI-02 asked to keep a rewritten docs/services/UI.md; DXC-15 / DCAT-05 delete it, so the current-state description lives here instead.

groups.name: tooling
groups.instructions:
Both tooling code units landed many changes (tooling-cold TCL-01..29 incl. deleting legacy/ in 7608faa; tooling-other TOT-01..20: rabbit fetch/watch are now non-destructive (04474dc), -e now overrides dev/tooling/.env (18a016d), --verbose dropped (cd79663), RabbitMQ discovery redone (0ac2f5b)). The review's statements about the CLI are largely stale: document the code.
Keep the cold doc set as it is (DTL-20 deferred: no per-tree split, no new docs/tooling/README.md). COLD.md becomes the home of what the commands share: '## Configuration' (DTL-05, DXC-11, DXC-12 / DPLT-11: every variable config.ts reads with its real default and layer, incl. the CATALOG_URL fallback and that an empty CATALOG_PORT in the archives module means docker picks a random port); '## The record' (DTL-12; every table in record/schema.ts, one line each; moved from COLD-VAULT.md:168-176); '## How Mega is trusted' (DTL-13; the three copies become one sentence plus a link each); 'Where things live' completed with paths and locks, and which commands take no lock (DTL-12); Origins as the CLI argument, 'tree' in prose (DXC-10); watching (DTL-15, TCL-19); 'The code' corrected and without the legacy row (DTL-17, TCL-14). COLD-PUSH/EVICT/PULL/VAULT/CATALOG/AUDIT point to those sections instead of restating them.
Per doc: DTL-03 (what removes, and whether it goes to the trash, per TCL-05 now), DTL-04 (no 'nothing in a container reads it'; COLD-VAULT.md#backedupcsv is the home of backedup.csv's format; stocker links it; keep the anchor), DTL-06 and DTL-07 (code changes: verify whether they landed, describe the result), DTL-14 (COLD-CATALOG 'Not built', the gap check and the one-page report leave: planning writes them into planning/COLD.md; COLD-PUSH's dated measurement), DTL-16 and DTL-19 docblocks, DTL-17, DTL-18 (ledger marks: pointer to STOCKER.md#the-ledger, cold's own conclusions only), TCL-05 (COLD-AUDIT: removal is offered only for partitions cold storage holds at the catalog version, and files go to the trash, if the code says so), TCL-19 (COLD-EVICT 'Running it alongside a push', COLD-AUDIT:53, COLD.md watching). legacy/ no longer exists: DXC-30 and DTL-11 reduce to COLD-AUDIT naming nothing as 'not rebuilt' (the ideas go to planning). Incoming: VOCABULARY's Snapshot mechanics (incremental snapshots) into COLD-CATALOG.md if missing (DPLT-13; entry cuts them); BINANCE.md L324-332 cold-storage state into COLD.md only if still true (DVEN-16 step 5; venues-b deletes).
dev/tooling/README.md (DTL-01, DTL-08, DTL-09, DXC-11): a `cold` entry with one sentence and a link; a two-line layout; env precedence exactly as src/shared/utils/env.ts does it now; rabbit as it behaves now; no RABBITMQ_MGMT_URL if nothing reads it; no -v; build first, `./tools` runs dist/; no 'Future Enhancements' (deleted). CLI help strings in index.ts are code: report mismatches. dev/tooling/.env.example (DPLT-11): the CATALOG_URL comment.
Docblocks you own: src/commands/cold.ts (DTL-04), src/tools/cold/push/archives/index.ts and lock.ts (DTL-16, TCL-19), shared/vault/fetch.ts and pull/archives/bring.ts (DTL-19); verify first, TCL commits may have done them.

groups.name: frozen
groups.instructions: NOT A WRITER GROUP: do not schedule. These files are listed only so that every doc file has exactly one owner. CLAUDE.md is the binding rule set. dx/** and packages/** are git submodules (separate repositories, out of the review's scope): any change goes to those repositories in a separate pass. services/.deprecated/** and dev/tooling/.deprecated/** document retired code and stay as they are (entry adds two moved BitMEX logs to dev/tooling/.deprecated/data/docs/; those two files are entry's). .github/agents, prompts and skills are Nx-generated. Flag to the owner: packages/service-kit/docs/README.md is an empty file.
